title: 'Medalist Movie' Reveals New Staff, Trailer, February 19 Premiere
content: The Medalist Special Exhibition 2026 event revealed the new staff, a second teaser visual (pictured), and special trailer for the anime sequel film adaptation of Tsurumaikada 's Medalist manga on Sunday. The anime movie is scheduled to premiere in Japanese theaters on February 19, 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Medalist Movie Reveals New Teaser Trailer, Visual, February 19, 2027 Premiere
content: Medalist sequel anime movie revealed a new trailer and visual, along with a February 19, 2027 premiere date. The movie was announced earlier this year, while the news came immediately after the TV anime’s second season concluded on March 22.
author: Anime Corner

title: Sankaku Head's My Darling Devilish Daughter Manga Ends in 6th Volume
content: The fifth volume of Sankaku Head 's My Darling Devilish Daughter ( Boku no Manamusume ) manga announced on Friday the series will end in the sixth volume, which ships in 2027. Seven Seas publishes the series in English and describes the story: Sami's just a sweet little girl…who happens to have demonic powers.
author: ANN

title: Kо̄ki Inо̄ Replaces Ayumu Murase as Kanon Himeno in The Idolm@ster Side M Franchise
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment 's Idolm@ster franchise announced on Friday voice actor Kо̄ki Inо̄ will take over the role of Kanon Himeno from Ayumu Murase in The Idolm@ster SideM franchise, after the company announced on August 18 Murase would "graduate" from the role.
author: ANN

title: Every Crunchyroll Anime Film of the Year Champion Since the Awards Began
content: Crunchyroll Anime Awards is one of the biggest events of the anime year, celebrating the biggest anime releases of the decade. The award ceremony has evolved since its inception, with more categories being added since 2017.
author: ComicBook

title: Gargoyles Live-Action Series Confirmed Dead By Creator & It Kills Another Disney+ Show
content: The creator behind Gargoyles has confirmed that the live-action series in development has been killed with Disney+, and it’s raising the question of what is still in the works with the streaming service in the future.
author: ComicBook

title: Attack on Titan Game Will End Service Sooner Than You Might Hope
content: Attack on Titan’s manga released its final chapter in 2021, with the anime adaptation sharing its last episode two years later, in 2023. Even though there are no sequels and/or spin-offs confirmed by series creator Hajime Isayama, this hasn’t stopped the beloved anime franchise from staying in the spotlight.
author: ComicBook

title: Re:Zero Studio Returns October 2026 With New Isekai – Watch the Trailer
content: The studio behind Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- is coming back this October with their next big Isekai anime hit, and they have dropped a new look at what to expect from this new series with a new trailer showing it all off.
author: ComicBook

title: Pokemon Kickstarts New Disney+ Exclusive Deal With First Look Trailer for Next Big Show – Watch
content: Pokémon and Disney are about to enter a new era of streaming, and that starts with the exclusive launch of a fun new series from the same stop-motion studio behind hits like Wallace & Gromit .
author: ComicBook

title: Spectacular Spider-Man’s Creator Talks Sequel Efforts
content: There have been more animated takes on Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man than we can count at this point, for good reason. Peter Parker’s journey is an easy one to chronicle in the animation department, though there remains one entry in his long tale that fans are still dying to see.
